name: Citizenship by Naturalisation, Reduced Residence for Spouses of Slovak Citizens

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years' permanent residence in Slovakia (versus 8 years on the general track).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous permanent residence while married to a Slovak citizen.

requirements.blocker_text: The remaining general naturalisation conditions still apply: Slovak language proficiency, clean criminal record, and tax/social-security/health-insurance compliance.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic (Washington consular page) -- citizenship acquisition: marriage to a Slovak citizen reduces the naturalisation residence requirement to 5 years (versus 8 years standard); foreign citizenship acquired through marriage does not automatically terminate Slovak citizenship while the marriage remains valid
